acceptanceDecision.reason: The version-pinned source file is a 27-run ANN/CAE modelling table containing simulation residual-stress/displacement outputs, hidden-layer values and predicted outputs. The companion article describes an integrated statistical, numerical-simulation and machine-learning workflow. The file does not expose a sufficiently clear raw measured injection-moulding signal/quality dataset to satisfy MouldMaster's measured-dataset acceptance boundary.
allowedUses: example of separating simulated/predicted outputs from measured evidence
prohibitedUses: counting toward fully profiled measured datasets
using simulated residual-stress outputs as measured sensor data

boundary: Profiling and rejection are both evidence work. Keeping this record prevents future candidate harvests from mistakenly promoting a simulation/ANN table as real measured process data.
